title: COLLECTION OF LIEUTENANT MATHEW DAVID BLACK PERSONAL/SERVICE ITEMS INCL INSCRIBED MEDALS PORTRAI...
description: COLLECTION OF LIEUTENANT MATHEW DAVID BLACK PERSONAL/SERVICE ITEMS INCL INSCRIBED MEDALS PORTRAIT & DEATH PENNY
findings: Group of WWI items to one man: Memorial Plaque (Dead Man's Penny) named MATHEW DAVID BLACK; 1914-15 Star reverse named '3 SGT M.D. BLACK 11/BN. A.I.F.' (11th Battalion AIF, Gallipoli-era); British War Medal and Victory Medal named '2/LIEUT. M.D. BLACK A.I.F.' (Victory medal rim reads 'M. D. BLACK. A.I.F.'); Rising Sun collar/hat badges (Australian Commonwealth Military Forces); miniatures on ribbons; framed hand-tinted portrait of soldier in uniform; trench-art style copper pens/pointer and a small brass telescope. Named group to an 11th Bn AIF sergeant later lieutenant with memorial plaque suggests he died on service, so the group is significant.
condition: Plaque has toning and minor spots; medals worn with some ribbon fading and a perspex ribbon mount; star and victory medal show brassy wear; badge lightly oxidised.
reason: Named AIF WWI group incl 1914-15 Star to 11th Bn (Gallipoli), BWM/Victory to officer and Memorial Plaque; strong collector demand, research value
marks_read: Star: 3 SGT M.D. BLACK 11/BN. A.I.F.; BWM/Victory: 2/LIEUT. M.D. BLACK A.I.F.; plaque: MATHEW DAVID BLACK
